entries.what: Jun works his usual 6:15 a.m. opening at Heron & Grind, pulling cortados for Wes and drinking a double ristretto between rushes.
entries.outcome: Smooth morning, no rush problems.

entries.what: After his shift he buys two cases of wrappers in aisle 6 at Ruiz Family Market and fills up at the Ruel Road station.
entries.outcome: Wrappers stowed in his hatchback trunk, savings a bit lower.

entries.what: Evening at Tess's house, he preps filling while old OPM ballads play, and Tess checks the coworker order list on the fridge.
entries.outcome: Filling ready for the weekend; Tess has seven dozen in orders.

entries.what: At the morning shift Linh shows Jun the finished spreadsheet with tabs for ingredients, kitchen hours and sales, and they move his receipt pile into it on break.
entries.outcome: The shoebox is retired and Linh's sheet becomes his bookkeeping.

entries.what: Jun asks around for a thank-you gift for Linh that isn't coffee and settles on a bakery box and a card from Panadería Las Hermanas.
entries.outcome: Plans to give it Thursday.

entries.what: Evening at home he enters the last receipts into the sheet and shows Tess the new totals.
entries.outcome: Tess is unimpressed but nods at the numbers.

entries.what: Heron & Grind starts its new 6:30 a.m. to 9 p.m. hours, and Jun's schedule shifts to Tue-Sat with him taking a 2-9 p.m. closing shift.
entries.outcome: He closes up with the night crew after the first student rush.

entries.what: Between rushes he teaches Linh a tulip pour and eats late al pastor from Taquería Colima on the way home.
entries.outcome: Linh lands her first clean tulip.

entries.what: Back home he finds Tess asleep, since she is off Wednesdays, and texts Paolo about Friday prep.
entries.outcome: Paolo replies with a thumbs up only.

entries.what: At lunch Jun gets the county email: fried lumpia with shrimp doesn't qualify as cottage food, so he needs a commissary and a health permit.
entries.outcome: Permit plan changes; he must use the commissary route.

entries.what: Within minutes he drafts a friendly note to Rick about the market waitlist but leaves the health permit packet unopened until the weekend.
entries.outcome: Note sent, packet pushed off.

entries.what: He gives Linh the Panadería box and a card at the end of their shift.
entries.outcome: Linh laughs and shares a concha with the crew.

entries.what: Closing shift at Heron & Grind, with Sam texting that he can't cover Saturday and Jun saying no.
entries.outcome: Jun keeps his Saturday counter slot for lumpia.

entries.what: Prep for Saturday at the Ruel Road commissary is a loose Friday evening block, and he scrubs the fryer area so Joan won't charge her fee.
entries.outcome: No $40 fee charged.

entries.what: Paolo is late again after his closing shift, so Jun rolls most of the batch himself until nearly midnight.
entries.outcome: About 150 lumpia rolled and frozen.

entries.what: First thing at the cafe, Jun sets out the Saturday table and sells lumpia at $10 a half dozen, with Wes buying his two for quarters.
entries.outcome: Sold out by early afternoon.

entries.what: On his break Jun drafts a firm group text to Paolo about prep, then softens it three times until it reads as a joke.
entries.outcome: Sends the joke version, and nothing changes.

entries.what: After his shift he passes the new Henríquez pupusa stand at the Ruel Road gas station lot while fueling up and grabs two pupusas.
entries.outcome: Learns the stand now has a permanent spot there.

entries.what: Jun finally opens the health permit packet at the kitchen table and starts filling it in, with Tess reading over his shoulder.
entries.outcome: Half the form filled, with questions marked for later.

entries.what: He plays pickup basketball at Delgado Park Sunday morning with his old crew before it gets hot.
entries.outcome: Wins two games and has a sore knee.

entries.what: Evening at home he rolls test batches while Tess critiques the filling and then adds her coworkers' orders to the fridge list.
entries.outcome: Tess approves of the onion level.
